guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: adservice has the dominant anomalies: error rate rose from 0 to 0.277, latency-50 rose +1242% and latency-90 +3062%, while workload fell 85%. CPU, memory and socket all dropped rather than rose, which fits a latency or delay fault with requests stalling (less work done) and rules out cpu, mem and socket exhaustion; the logs are empty and the traces do not include adservice, so the fault type is inferred from metrics alone.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect adservice for network delay or latency injection (e.g. tc/netem rules, sidecar or network policy changes) and remove it; if none is found, restart the adservice pod and check its upstream dependencies. Non-destructive.
